mapping.author: claude-mapper-fdn-m5
mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Dragonmaster Outcast: "At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control six or more lands, create
# a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying."
# Event: "at the beginning of your upkeep" (MAPPER_GUIDE); the intervening "if" is the condition,
# M21 Fabled Passage's "if you control four or more lands" at six; the token as Roost of Drakes'
# flying Drake, a 5/5 red Dragon.
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.UPKEEP,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
        count=QConst(value=6),
        inner_filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Dragon',
            type_line='Creature — Dragon',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Dragon',),
            power=QConst(value=5),
            toughness=QConst(value=5),
            keywords=(Keyword.FLYING,),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('R',),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control six or more lands, create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.

mapping.notes: Your-upkeep TurnPhaseEvent; the intervening 'if' is the condition (Fabled Passage's CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE lands, 6); a 5/5 red flying Dragon TokenSpec. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: dragonmaster_outcast_your_upkeep_makes_it, dragonmaster_outcast_six_lands_make_a_dragon, dragonmaster_outcast_five_lands_make_nothing.
